title: Sweet Potato Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 15 oz. canned black beans, drained and rinsed, or 1.5 cups cooked black beans
8 oz. Monterrey Jack or Mexican cheese, divided
2 oz. crumbled feta or Cotija cheese
2 cups salsa verde or enchilada sauce
2 Tbsp sour cream or Greek yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Slice the sweet potatoes lengthwise and coat with olive oil. Place them flat side down on the baking sheet. Bake about 20-25 minutes until tender and cooked through.
Pour enough salsa verde or enchilada sauce into a lasagna pan to lightly cover the bottom.
In a mixing bowl, add the cooked (and skinned) sweet potatoes, black beans, chiles, 4 oz. of cheese, feta/Cotija, garlic, cumin, lime juice, salt, and pepper and combine. This is the filling
Add about 1/2 cup of the filling into the center of one tortilla, fold over, and place folded side down into the lasagna pan.
Repeat for all the tortillas until the lasagna pan is full - about 8-10 tortillas.
Top with remaining salsa verde/enchilada sauce and 4 oz. cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes until the sauce is bubbling and cheese is lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let the enchiladas cool for about 10 minutes.
Whisk sour cream/yogurt with water and drizzle over the enchiladas.
Garnish with cilantro and onions. The enchiladas are ready to serve
